say:1:1310136001:0.text: It is time for us to set out.
say:1:1310136001:0.source_cn: 诸位，天已经大亮，我们可以出发了。

say:2:1310136002:0.text: Sir Faramor, we won't be attending the festival. We're going to hire a carriage and go home.
say:2:1310136002:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，我们……不去参加祭典了，我们打算雇辆车回家……

say:3:1310136003:0.text: Romain's still weak, and he hasn't fully recovered from the shock of last night...
say:3:1310136003:0.source_cn: 小罗曼的身体还有些虚弱，还在睡着，也没从昨晚的惊吓里回...

say:6:1310136004:0.text: Traveling with a child is difficult... how about this? I'll stay behind and help you out!
say:6:1310136004:0.source_cn: 你们带着孩子也不太方便……这样吧，我对这一带还算熟，我...

say:7:1310136005:0.text: We couldn't possibly impose... but, actually, thank you so much, Mr. Swafford.
say:7:1310136005:0.source_cn: 这、这怎么好意思……好吧，太感谢您了，斯瓦夫先生。

say:11:1310136006:0.text: You've got guts and a good heart! Swafford, drop by Artisan Avenue sometime. I'll introduce you to some top dwarf craftsmen!
say:11:1310136006:0.source_cn: 你很不错，有胆量，人也好。斯瓦夫，有空来工匠街坐坐，我...

say:12:1310136007:0.text: Oh, that would be fantastic! I've always wanted to meet the master craftsmen!
say:12:1310136007:0.source_cn: 哎呀，那真是太好了……我早就想认识各位矮人工匠大师啦！

say:15:1310136008:0.text: Thank you, Mr. Swafford. Now that all is in order, Magister, shall we depart?
say:15:1310136008:0.source_cn: 多谢你，斯瓦夫先生。既然这里的事情已经处理完毕，魔法师...
say:15:1310136008:0.male: Thank you, Mr. Swafford. Now that all is in order, Magister, shall we depart?
say:15:1310136008:0.female: Thank you, Mr. Swafford. Now that all is in order, Magister, shall we depart?
